sources.claim: AI glasses shipments surged 263% YoY in H1 2026; Meta holds 94% of display-less AI glasses segment
sources.notes: Secondary report citing Counterpoint Research primary data (September 2026). Counterpoint is a reputable market research firm. Figures are shipments to retailers, not consumer sell-through.

sources.claim: EssilorLuxottica sold over 7 million pairs of AI-enabled glasses in 2025; Meta's Ray-Ban is revolutionizing the wearable market
sources.notes: Omdia is Informa Tech's market research division. EssilorLuxottica is the manufacturer and provided the 7M figure in official statements.

sources.claim: Global wearable AI devices market valued at $69.8 billion in 2026, growing at 14.5% CAGR to $270.2 billion by 2036
sources.notes: Paid research report (summary free). Meticulous Research is a credentialed market research firm. Definition of 'wearable AI' is broader than AI glasses alone — treat as upper bound for the category.

sources.claim: EU regulators targeting AI smart glasses enforcement; CNIL action plan issued May 2026; European Data Protection Board commissioned social acceptability report
sources.notes: Covers CNIL warning (France) and EDPB activity. Crosscheck against CNIL.fr and edpb.europa.eu for primary source confirmation.

sources.claim: EPIC urges FTC to block Meta's facial recognition 'Name Tag' feature for Ray-Ban smart glasses (February 2026)
sources.notes: Primary source — EPIC is the organization that filed the letter. Confirms FTC advocacy but no FTC enforcement action confirmed as of research date.

sources.publisher: Yahoo Finance / Smart Glasses Market Report
sources.claim: Smart glasses market projected to quadruple by 2031 as generative AI transforms eyewear into personal assistant platform
sources.notes: Yahoo Finance aggregation of market research report. Growth projections are forecasts and should be treated as directional estimates.

sources.claim: Meta leads the post-smartphone hardware race; Google, OpenAI, Apple, and Snap all chasing; privacy concerns mounting as sales hit millions
sources.notes: Tier-1 journalism source. September 2026 feature article confirming competitive dynamics and privacy debates. Highly reliable for market narrative.

sources.claim: Meta's Ray-Ban smart glasses shipments jumped 263% in H1 2026; Meta's own volumes rose 260% YoY per Counterpoint Research
sources.notes: English-language summary of Counterpoint Research data published by Digital Today. Corroborates Newsy Today figures from the same Counterpoint report.

sources.claim: Smart glasses shipment statistics and growth data; Counterpoint: 156% YoY in 2023, 210% in 2024, 110% H1 2025
sources.notes: Reputable Android/tech publisher tracking Counterpoint shipment data across multiple quarters. Good for historical context on category growth trajectory.

sources.claim: IDC: Meta held 69.2% overall smart glasses market share in Q1 2026; 2.25M display-less units shipped in Q1 2026
sources.notes: IDC figure differs from Counterpoint (69% vs 94%) because IDC includes display-equipped glasses in total while Counterpoint focuses on display-less segment. Both are valid but measure different market cuts.

data_gaps.note: ~800K/mo is an estimate based on category scale. No direct keyword tool data (Google Trends, Keywords Everywhere) was available for exact monthly search volume. Treat as directional.
+2,100% is derived from near-zero (Ray-Ban Stories launch 2021) to 8.7M units (2025, Omdia). Exact CAGR comparison requires 2021 baseline unit data which was not found in search results.
Star ratings are approximate consumer review averages from product listing aggregators (Amazon, Best Buy). Not from a formal brand sentiment survey.
